name: Jonah
summary: A prophet, the son of Amittai, whom the LORD sent to warn the great city of Nineveh. He ran from the LORD, was swallowed by a great fish, and was angry when God spared the city.

key_moments.title: Running from the LORD
key_moments.description: The LORD told Jonah to go and cry against Nineveh for its wickedness. Instead Jonah fled to Joppa and paid for a ship heading the other way, to Tarshish.

key_moments.title: Thrown into the Sea
key_moments.description: The LORD sent a great storm, and the lot showed the sailors that Jonah was the cause. At his word they threw him overboard, the sea grew calm, and a great fish swallowed him for three days and nights.

key_moments.title: Prays from Inside the Fish
key_moments.description: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God and thanked Him for hearing him. Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it threw Jonah up onto dry land.

key_moments.title: Warns Nineveh, and the City Turns
key_moments.description: Jonah walked into Nineveh crying that in forty days the city would be overthrown. The people believed God, fasted and turned from their wicked ways, and God did not destroy them.

key_moments.title: Angry When God Spares Nineveh
key_moments.description: Jonah was angry that God spared Nineveh. God grew a gourd to shade him and then sent a worm to kill it, and asked whether He should not spare that great city with all its people.
